knownLimits: Current bridge and culvert elevations unknown; no structure openings
Published CN antecedent assumption (GCN10 fair ARCII undrained); no measured transmission loss

Terrain is bare-earth lidar: 1 m PimaCounty_2021_B21 and Eastern_PimaCO_2015 in road/wash windows (2015 covers most of the mid/upper Brawley mainstem and San Joaquin/Black Wash); 10 m context mixes all-route-context-v2, 2021, BrawleyRillito 2018 (flown 2019), 2015 and 0.98 km2 of USGS 1/3 arc-second; not a 2026 survey
2021 minus 2015 seam offset about -0.11 m median in 7 road windows; not corrected
6.25 m computational cells are not validated road-depth accuracy; compare cell water-surface elevation zs with road height, never averaged depth
Catchment-based domain excludes Avra Valley Rd west, Anway and Agua Dulce Ranch and most of Cocorague Ranch and Tucker (they drain to Northern inlet reaches or other non-local reaches)
The 27.47 km2 local catchment of 15876941 below USGS 09487000 is excluded; its runoff enters only through the inlet series
Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange; overlaps Gates by 139.42 km2 (independent model)
